description: Puerta de requisitos (hermes-sdd): ordena los supuestos (sección «## Supuestos» de REQUIREMENTS.md, clase S de references/modo-arnes.md) por lo probable que es que el cliente los quiera distintos, para enseñarle primero los que más conviene mirar. Un ítem por supuesto, state = {encargo: la petición literal del cliente, supuesto: una línea}. Solo ordena: nunca aprueba ni rechaza nada.

objetable.instructions: A customer asked for a piece of software with the words in `encargo`. Where the request did not say, the team wrote down the assumption `supuesto` and built it that way. Judge how likely it is that THIS customer, reading the assumption, would want it different.
criteria: Any customer would accept it: it is the usual choice, or it follows directly from what the customer wrote.
A reasonable choice, though this customer could prefer another equally reasonable option; little would change for them.
It shapes something the customer or their users will notice in daily use (a limit, a deadline, who can do what, what happens in a common case), and they may well want it different.
It goes against, narrows or adds to what the customer wrote, or decides something only the customer can decide (money, legal, privacy, who is responsible).
